<message>
I always boast about my cool, digital normad lifestyle. But deep down I feel lonely.
</message>

<passage>
You yourself are a part of a social system necessary to complete the whole. Accordingly, let your every action be a similar part of the social life. And if any action has not its reference, either immediate or distant, to the common good as its end, this action disorders your life and frustrates its unity. It is sedition like that of the man who, in a commonwealth, does all in his power to sever himself from the general harmony and concord.
</passage>

output.reason: Encourages reflecting on social connection and purpose, addressing loneliness through contribution to community.
